def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    truck_patches = image_patch.find("truck")
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")
    
    if not truck_patches or not road_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    road_centers = [(r.left + r.right) / 2 for r in road_patches]
    truck_centers = [(t.left + t.right) / 2 for t in truck_patches]
    
    right_trucks = [t for t, center_t in zip(truck_patches, truck_centers) if all(center_r < center_t for center_r in road_centers)]
    
    return right_trucks
